result_assessed: 3-point MACE (CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke), hazard ratio, effect of assignment (ITT)

D1_randomisation.why: Central IWRS 1:1 with visually identical placebo, stratified by SGLT2i use; no major baseline imbalances.

witnesses.span: Participants were randomly assigned 1:1, using a central interactive web response system, to receive OW subcutaneous (s.c.) injections of semaglutide 1.0 mg or visually identical placebo
There were no major imbalances between groups for baseline participant characteristics

D2_deviations_assignment.why: Participants, investigators and trial personnel blinded; ITT estimand (irrespective of adherence), FAS = all randomised as assigned.

witnesses.span: Participants, investigators and all trial personnel (except the independent data monitoring committee) are blinded to treatment assignment.

The estimand for all objectives is an intention-to-treat estimand, evaluating the effect of the randomised treatment intervention irrespective of adherence to treatment and changes to background medication.
Vital status was known in 98.6% of participants
These events are reviewed by an independent external event adjudication committee (EAC) in a blinded manner

D5_selection_of_reported_result.why: Design paper (Jan 2023, before the Oct 2023 stop) and SAP v1.0 (07-Apr-2019) name 3-point MACE a confirmatory secondary endpoint analysed by stratified Cox.

witnesses.span: Confirmatory secondary endpoints are annual rate of change of eGFR (total eGFR slope), time to first occurrence of three-point MACE
The confirmatory secondary time-to-event endpoints are analysed using the stratified Cox proportional hazards model as described for the primary endpoint.

D2_treatment_discontinuation.note: stopped treatment -- recorded for D2 context; NOT missing outcome data
D2_treatment_discontinuation.why: permanent discontinuation 28.8% (pooled); protocol keeps discontinuers in follow-up

witnesses.span: permanent discontinuation of randomized treatment was reported in 28.8%

overall.rule: RoB 2 algorithm on the proposals; not computed when any domain lacks evidence
